meta.description: Harden an application or service against common attack vectors. Use when asked to improve security posture, secure an API, harden a server, or prepare for a security review.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对应用或服务进行安全加固以应对常见攻击。
copy.tagline_en: Harden applications and services against common attacks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to harden an application or service against common attack vectors.

howto.what: Claude 会按分层流程系统检查应用或服务的认证、输入验证、秘密管理、依赖与基础设施，并输出一份按严重程度排序的安全修复建议清单。
howto.when: 当用户要求改善安全态势、保护API、加固服务器或准备安全审查时触发。

say.note: Claude会执行分层安全检查并给出修复建议。
Claude会重点检查认证和输入验证。
Claude会遍历所有检查点并输出优先级列表。

howto.what_en: Claude systematically checks authentication, input validation, secrets management, dependencies, and infrastructure of an app/service, then outputs a prioritized list of security fixes by severity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to improve security posture, secure an API, harden a server, or prepare for a security review.

say_en.text: Harden this web application for me.
say_en.note: Claude runs layered checks and suggests fixes.
Claude focuses on auth and input validation.
Claude iterates all checkpoints and outputs a priority list.
